subject: Opening the evaluation roadmap & owners
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha@heliomed.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@heliomed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Opening the evaluation roadmap & owners

Hi Aisha / Tom —

Thanks again for the time last week. As discussed, I wanted to put a short, practical roadmap on your calendar so we can align owners, deliverables, and a realistic close target. I sketched a 30-day evaluation plan that focuses on three core outcomes:

- Technical validation (latency/cost benchmarks on a representative prompt set)
- Security & compliance check (SOC2 artifacts + data handling q&a)
- Integration proof-of-concept (sample endpoints + tokenization/formatting)

Attached: MAP-outline-HelioMed-v1.pdf — this is a lightweight draft you can iterate on. My asks for the first step:

1) Confirm the project champion and primary technical contact (I noted Aisha/Tom but please confirm other stakeholders).
2) Confirm procurement contact for scope-of-work and initial PO discussion.
3) Pick one 30–45 minute slot next week for a kickoff sync to finalize owners and the 30-day milestones.

Proposed timeline (high level):
- Week 0 (this week): align stakeholders + kickoff meeting
- Week 1–2: test harness + sample prompts (our infra + your sample data)
- Week 3: security review + artifacts exchange
- Week 4: demo + decision checkpoint (go/no-go / next steps)

If that looks reasonable, Aisha — could you confirm the champion and add any other names we should include? Tom — would you be the day-to-day technical lead? Marissa (cc) and Camila (cc) from my side will coordinate on the test harness and logistics — I’ve attached a short outline for the MAP.

Thanks, and looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: MAP-outline-HelioMed-v1.pdf (attachment stub)
From: Aisha Patel <aisha@heliomed.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@heliomed.com>, Priya Kumar <procurement@heliomed.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 10:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Opening the evaluation roadmap & owners

Thanks Rishi — this looks great and much appreciated. Confirming a few items on our side:

- Champion: Aisha Patel (me) — overall project owner and decision influencer.
- Technical lead: Tom Ellis (cc) — will run the tests and coordinate our infra access.
- Procurement: Priya Kumar (procurement@heliomed.com) — handling SOW/PO once scope is set.

We do have a security gating item: our security team will want the SOC2 report and a short summary of logging/evidence retention before we hand over any sample data. Is Redwood able to provide that during week 3 as you outlined?

For the kickoff, I’m available next week on: Wed 7/23 10–11am PT or Thu 7/24 2–3pm PT. Either works for Tom as well — Tom, confirm which you prefer.

Aisha
Aisha Patel
Director of ML Platforms | HelioMed
aisha@heliomed.com | +1 (617) 555-0124
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha@heliomed.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@heliomed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Priya Kumar <procurement@heliomed.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 10:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Opening the evaluation roadmap & owners

Perfect — thanks for confirming, Aisha. Quoting your note below.

> We do have a security gating item: our security team will want the SOC2 report and a short summary of logging/evidence retention before we hand over any sample data. Is Redwood able to provide that during week 3 as you outlined?

Short answer: yes. Marissa: can you confirm we can provide SOC2 report and a short SIEM/log-retention summary in week 3 (or earlier if helpful)? I’ve attached a brief one-pager that covers the common asks so the HelioMed team can pre-scan it.

Kickoff — let’s lock Wed 2025-07-23 10:00–10:30 PT. Tom, if that slot looks good I’ll send a calendar invite with an agenda: 1) confirm owners, 2) agree sample prompts and data restrictions, 3) timeline + milestones, 4) next steps for procurement.

Next steps from my side: we’ll prepare the test harness repo, share instructions for a minimal access plan, and drop the MAP draft into a Drive folder. Priya — I’ll coordinate with you after the kickoff for SOW scope items.

Attachments: Redwood-Security-OnePager.pdf (attachment stub)

Thanks — Rishi
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
